name: Seoul Open 2024

venue.name: [중구구민회관 (Jung-gu Citizen Hall)](https://www.e-junggu.or.kr/fmcs/156)

information: ## 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ## 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 등록되니, 참가신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해주세요. 참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulOpen2024#36730-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요. 요청시, 모든 참가자가 스태프로 활동해주셔야 합니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. ___ ## Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ## Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see you name on either the competitor list or waitlist. Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulOpen2024#36730-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information. All participants are expected to staff the competition, upon request. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
